headline: Colonial Advances Reshape Weathered Expanse as Central Lines Bleed
war_summary: Linn of Mercy and Weathered Expanse have witnessed dramatic shifts across the map over the past three hours. In Weathered Expanse, an intense burst of nine base turnovers within the last two hours swung the balance, lifting Colonial holdings to five bases while reducing Warden authority to a lone position alongside three ruined neutral settlements. Linn of Mercy saw Warden forces forfeit their remaining footholds, ceding ten bases to Colonial control with one redoubt left neutral, even as combat drained over seven hundred casualties in two hours. Mooring County registered three fresh exchanges around The Wind Hills, though the hex remains locked under eleven Warden bases and one neutral ruin. Meanwhile, the violent see-saw in Marban Hollow and Stlican Shelf has ground to an operational halt, recording zero base shifts over the past two hours. Nevish Line similarly marked no recent handovers, yet its trenchlines continue to bleed heavily, devouring over twelve hundred casualties in two hours alongside persistent pressure in Stonecradle.
